discussion_comments.comment_body: [P2, nonblocking] Loading the cloud model catalog under an organization and then switching to Personal before starting a cloud session retains the cached organization catalog, so ClinePass remains missing from `/model`.

Fixed in caa6e7e14. `/model` now fetches a fresh catalog each time it opens and replaces the cached one, so switching to Personal brings ClinePass back, and default model resolution uses the refreshed list too.

[P2, nonblocking] When the transcript contains base64 images generated by the assistant, each subsequent snapshot writes those same images into fresh temporary directories, accumulating duplicate files until the CLI exits.

Fixed in 94a778f9a. `materializeGeneratedMedia` now caches by a hash of the media type and data, so re-hydrating the same transcript on each snapshot reuses the file it already wrote instead of creating a new temp folder. The cache is cleared together with the folders on exit. Added a test for it.
Good catch, fixed in 8a327a6: refresh now clears the content cache (the active tab re-reads immediately) and closing a tab drops its entry so reopening re-reads.

Fixed in 0c51c9c: each path carries a read generation that is bumped when its cache entry is dropped (refresh, tab close, agent edit), and responses from a superseded generation are discarded. Added a test that holds a read open across a refresh and checks the stale response does not replace the fresh contents.

Fixed in 3e546f0: instead of comparing a counts-based signature, every new repository snapshot marks cached diffs and file contents stale; the active view re-reads while keeping the previous contents on screen so polling does not flash a spinner.
